//: THIS CONFIG TYPECHECKS ONLY — noEmit, no build output. The RUNNABLE output
comes from esbuild instead (`npm run build` → dist/main.mjs), which both
`npm start` and the container run. tsc could not produce it: the shared
guards this service imports reach their siblings with extensionless
specifiers (`./keys`, CLAUDE.md's house rule) and tsc does not rewrite those
into something Node's ESM resolver can follow, whereas a bundler resolves
them at build time. So the two tools split the job — tsc grades the types,
esbuild produces the artifact — and neither duplicates the other.
It deliberately does NOT extend the root tsconfig: that one carries jsx,
the DOM lib and Next's plugin, none of which belong in a server with no
browser and no Next. It repeats the compiler options it needs instead.
`include` reaches OUT of this folder for the two shared modules. That is the
point of the refactor they came from — the gateway grades the same source
the app grades, so a change to a guard cannot typecheck here and fail there.
